extraction.notes: Pages seq 11 and seq 36 are duplicates; seq 11 used. Dollar reconciliation ties: -203 + adjustments = FFO 14,842; + core adjustments = Core FFO 19,940; + AFFO adjustments = Core AFFO 19,753. Diluted share count is not printed on the provided pages (footnote 2 gives only OP unit counts of 8,589 thousand for the quarter), so diluted_shares is a placeholder of 0 and per-share figures could not be re-derived; it should be filled from the company's weighted average share count. Judgment calls: land and other impairments mapped to re_impairment (land is non-depreciable; closest category); amortization of derivative premium mapped to derivative_mtm (not a financing-cost amortization); market lease intangibles and lease inducements mapped to straight_line_rent as similar non-cash revenue adjustments; the Core AFFO capex lines are labeled 'Non-incremental revenue generating capital expenditures' and mapped to recurring_capex since the company deducts them in AFFO. Zero-amount lines (discontinued ops D&A, JV gain, discontinued disposition gain, lease inducements) recorded as 0 as printed em-dashes.
